transport: static files over HTTPS (GitHub Pages); GET only; no authentication; CORS: same as GitHub Pages defaults

versioning.policy: Paths are stable; artifacts are replaced in place on each publish and identified by sha256 + generated_at. manifest-history.jsonl records every publish (append-only). Per-run KSI history is immutable per file. A path rename or field removal bumps manifest_version.

categories.cso: Public information about the cloud service offering (CDS-CSO-PUB)
categories.ksi: Key Security Indicator validation output and register (FRC-*, SDR-*)
categories.vdr: Vulnerability detection and response data (VDR-*, VER-*)
categories.mas: Minimum Assessment Standard boundary and dashboard data (MAS-*)
categories.assessments: Independent assessment reports and FedRAMP certification documents (CDS-CSO-FRC, IVV-*)
categories.schemas: JSON Schemas for the machine-readable artifacts
categories.meta: Trust Center bundle manifests and scheduling
categories.foci: Foreign ownership, control or influence register (KSI-PIY-DFC/RFP/RFB/MFD, RFC-0036)

artifacts.description: Public CSO record: FedRAMP ID, UEI, service/deployment model, business category, contacts, service description, access methods.
Security and FedRAMP contact addresses, quarterly-review mechanism.
Next Ongoing Certification Report and quarterly review dates, last data refresh, data-quality flags.
Quarterly review session schedule and registration.
Current verdict for every KSI and FRR family: assertion, status, mode, score, per-resource evaluations (redacted), command executions, rules version, certification profile.
The per-KSI validation register: every automated check (command, note, expected output, Mode 2 metric hint) the engine executes.
Active KSI failures and the full failure/remediation history with time-to-remediate.
Non-gating statistical observations (stability, credential hygiene, root activity) — aggregate only.
Append-only roll-up per validation run since 2025-11-18: total / passed / failed / compliance rate (one JSON object per run).

Per-run, per-KSI status snapshots at 4-hour granularity since 2025-05-29 (status, mode, score, resource counts for all KSIs and FRR families). The index lists every snapshot URL; files are immutable once written. Retention: indefinite (historical-data/RETENTION_POLICY.md).
Weekly security-investment activity metrics (commits, Dependabot, CI success).
Public vulnerability detection and response metrics: population, N-rating distribution, LEV/IRV classification, acceptance tracking, remediation timeliness.
Extended VDR metrics (weekly/monthly layers).
Vulnerability detection and response report (machine-readable).
Significant change notification report.
Recent classified infrastructure change events.
Ongoing Certification Report (machine-readable).
Quarterly review report (machine-readable).
Ongoing certification report snapshot, Q4 2025 (historical certification data).
Human-readable rendering of the current KSI validation output.
Human-readable quarterly report.
Provenance of the generated reports.
Authorization boundary: zones, integrations, Terraform-vs-AWS drift record, fingerprint.
Unified MAS dashboard (services, cost drift, boundary drift).
Machine-readable Secure Configuration Guide (settings, defaults, rule coverage, release history).
Continuous Remediation Register — public-safe per-resource findings with state tracking.
Customer responsibility matrix (NIST 800-53 Rev 5 mapping), machine-readable.
Customer responsibility matrix with CMMC/CUI overlay (human-readable).
Index of independent assessment reports and FedRAMP certification documents with scope, result and file names.
CR26 KSI traceability matrix.
Manifest of the Trust Center data bundle (schemas, reports, assessments, policies) with SHA-256 per file; the same bundle is released as trust-center-data.zip.
Validation pipeline execution quality (command success, collector health).
Integrity seals and consistency checks for the published validation output.
Run-over-run consistency log (fingerprint flaps, timing).
Human-readable guide to the Trust Center data bundle and historical package access.
Independent assessment report (Fortreum), 2026-01-30 — human-readable; indexed by assessment-reports-manifest.
Security assessment report, 2025-12-19 — human-readable.
FedRAMP 20x authorization letter — human-readable.

Public-safe FOCI register structure: ownership declaration state, foreign-persons count, business relationships with FOCI relevance and review state, USG determinations. Sensitive details are held only in the private record.
FOCI register review cadence, change triggers, handling rules and the aggregate-only metric derivation.
